notes.title: Emotionless is part of the Debut Festival!
notes.notes:
[p]From August 7th to 11th, Emotionless: The Last Ticket will participate in the Debut Festival - a celebration of first-time games!

Play our free demo, already tried by more than 100 streamers. Also, we'll be streaming our dev playing Emotionless during the event.

Make sure to check and support other first games from many other fresh devs too![/p]

notes.title: Localization Incoming!
notes.notes: [p]We're working on localizing [b]Emotionless: The Last Ticket[/b] into multiple languages to make the experience available to players around the world. Stay tuned, because we'll announce each language as soon as they are all implemented and tested.[/p][p]Thank you for your support and for screaming in every language with us![/p]

notes.title: Your ticket awaits in September
notes.notes: [p]Step into a twisted world in Emotionless: The Last Ticket, set for release on September 18 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3570000/EMOTIONLESS__The_Last_Ticket/"]on Steam[/url]. An atmospheric horror game inspired by classic and cosmic horror, Emotionless: The Last Ticket will drop you into a creepy amusement park and, through its haunting plot and atmosphere, take you on a surreal trip as you try to find you way out.[/p]

notes.title: Demo is updated!
notes.notes:
[p][b][i]Hello our emotionless people![/i][/b][/p][p]Just to let you know – we added some cool new features. If you want to check it out, just update the demo and click on [b][u]“New Game”[/u][/b]. 

And thanks to everyone who played and gave their feedback. It helps us to improve our game and your experience![/p]

notes.title: DEMO is live!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Demo is now available to play![/b][/p][p]The demo contains the first map of the amusement park and three maps from the underground area. You'll be able to explore the spooky park hidden within the forest, descend into twisted tunnels, squeeze through narrow halls, and wander liminal spaces. You’ll also get hints about the narrative—just enough to make you wonder, as the full story will become clearer in the full release.[/p][p]We are very grateful to everyone who already tested the demo and gave us feedback. It’s very much appreciated and helps us improve the overall experience. We hope you’ll all have a great time playing the demo, just as much as we did while developing it.

Till next time, stay emotionless![/p]

notes.title: Emotionless: The Last Ticket is Coming to Steam Next Fest – June 10–17!
notes.notes:
[b]But you won’t have to wait much longer because we’re releasing the demo a few days early to gather feedback and bug reports.

Playtest early and help us shape the experience!
Wishlist now and stay tuned for the early drop![/b]
